headline: Approved purpose statement and one-year timeline for parent and caregiver engagement ad hoc committee.
summary: The superintendent and Steven Mogul described family engagement across the district's 11 schools, along with barriers such as meeting times and few regular participants. They discussed moving from ClassDojo to a platform called Rooms and ways to recruit families for advisory councils. The group approved a purpose statement and a one-year timeline for the ad hoc committee, with a six-month check-in.
decisions: Approved the 6.3.26 Parent and Community Engagement Committee meeting minutes, 2-0.
Acknowledged the purpose statement as amended to include DPAC, 2-0.
Approved the amended timeline for the ad hoc committee, with a one-year term and a six-month check-in, 2-0.
